column2: 34. The objectives of the Institute shall be :—
the identification of areas connected to the tourism
industry where training of personnel is needed and
obtaining  the  services  of  the  best  academic  and
professional trainers is essential;
the development of curricula in identified areas of
study,
to provide tertiary education and vocational training
in subjects related to tourism, to such extent as the
same is required for the development of tourism;
to co-operate with persons or bodies training persons
both local or foreign to engage in work wholly or
partly connected with tourism;
to  award  certificates  of  participation  to  each
individual indicating the nature of the qualification
obtained from the Institute;
to  own,  manage  and  participate  in  the  ownership
and  management  of  schools  and  training  centres
wholly or partly connected with tourism; and
to exercise, perform and discharge the powers, duties
and functions conferred or imposed on the Institute
by or under this Act or any other law in force for the
time being for the purpose of the attainment of its
objectives.
